name: @agentproto/skill-pack-bureau
description: @agentproto/skill-pack-bureau — the bureau-plugin skill pack (authenticated browser automation, LinkedIn, X/Twitter, YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, news/media extraction, marketplace scraping). Source of truth for both the Claude Code plugin bundle (.claude-plugin/plugin.json + skills/) and `agentproto install skill/<slug> --pack bureau-plugin`. Edit src/skills/*, never skills/ or .claude-plugin/ directly — those are generated by `pnpm build`.
